visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short black hair and a silver necklace is shown from the chest up, wearing a light yellow knitted sweater. She holds a grey sock close to the camera lens. (2) She lowers the grey sock and presents a white sock, looking directly into the lens with a neutral expression. (3) The camera cuts to a full-body shot of the woman standing in a living room; she wears a blue long-sleeved shirt and a plaid skirt, with one grey and one white sock pulled up to her shins. (4) Close-up shots follow, focusing on her hands rubbing and stretching the white sock's fabric against a wooden surface. (5) She is seen again in the full-body view, turning her legs to compare the different heights of the two socks. (6) Static screenshots of an e-commerce interface appear, displaying images of pink and white socks with price information in Chinese characters. (7) The woman returns to the talking-head frame, using her hands to emphasize points while glancing toward a point off-camera.
